title: LLM-Driven Automation in FIB-SEM: Enhancing Microscope Control with AutoScript and Vision-Based AI
content: Focused Ion Beam Scanning Electron Microscopy (FIB-SEM) is a critical tool for materials science, offering precise site-specific sample modifications combined with high resolution imaging. However, its operation requires extensive expertise in specimen manipulation, ion beam milling, and imaging parameter optimization. To address this challenge, we introduce the EMCoPilot, a Python-based proof-of-concept application that enhances the efficiency, reproducibility, and accessibility of FIB-SEM workflows through multi-modal vision-enabled AI, foundational segmentation models, and automated execution of AutoScript commands.
